stories.title: 📜 Gospel of Thomas
summaryBullets: [J]“Old man will not hesitate to ask a little child about the place of life, and he will live. Many who are first will become last, and the last first.”[/J] (sayings 4–5).

[J]“Jesus said to his disciples, Compare me to someone and tell me whom I am like.”[/J] They answer variously; Jesus says, [J]“I am not your master… Rather, you have become intoxicated.”[/J] (sayings 13–15).
Intro: These are the secret sayings of Jesus recorded by Didymus Judas Thomas (saying 1).
[J]“Whoever finds the interpretation of these sayings will not taste death.”[/J] (saying 1).
[J]“Let him who seeks continue seeking until he finds. When he finds, he will be troubled. When troubled, he will marvel, and will reign over all.”[/J] (saying 2).
[J]“If those who lead you say the kingdom is in the sky, the birds will precede you; if in the sea, the fish will precede you. The kingdom is inside you and outside you.”[/J] (saying 3).

[J]“The man old in days will not hesitate to ask a small child seven days old about the place of life, and he will live. For many who are first will become last, and they will become one and the same.”[/J] (saying 4).
[J]“Recognize what is in your sight, and that which is hidden from you will become plain to you. For there is nothing hidden which will not become manifest.”[/J] (saying 5).

[J]“When you fast, you bring sin upon yourselves; when you pray, you will be condemned; when you give alms, you will harm your spirits… But when you go into any land, if they receive you, eat what is set before you.”[/J] (saying 6).
[J]“Blessed is the lion which man eats, so that the lion becomes man; cursed is the man whom a lion eats, and the lion becomes man.”[/J] (saying 7).
[J]“The kingdom is like a wise fisherman who casts his net, chooses the large fish, and throws away the small.”[/J] (saying 8).
[J]“The man has discovered a treasure hidden in his field, and he began to lend money at interest to whomever he wished.”[/J] (saying 9).
[J]“I have cast fire upon the world, and behold, I guard it until it blazes.”[/J] (saying 10).
[J]“This heaven will pass away, and the one above it will pass away. The dead are not alive, and the living will not die.”[/J] (saying 11).
[J]“On the day when you were one, you became two. But when you become two, what will you do?”[/J] (saying 11–12).

[J]“The disciples said, We know you will leave us. Who will be great over us? Jesus said, Wherever you are, you are to go to James the Just, for whose sake heaven and earth came into being.”[/J] (saying 12).

Jesus said to his disciples, [J]“Compare me to someone and tell me whom I am like.”[/J] Simon Peter said to him, “You are like a righteous angel.” Matthew said to him, “You are like a wise philosopher.” Thomas said to him, “Master, my mouth is wholly incapable of saying whom you are like.” Jesus said, [J]“I am not your master. Because you have drunk, you have become intoxicated from the bubbling spring which I have measured out.”[/J] And he took him and withdrew and told him three things. When Thomas returned to his companions, they asked him, “What did Jesus say to you?” Thomas said to them, “If I tell you one of the things which he told me, you will pick up stones and throw them at me; a fire will come out of the stones and burn you up.” (saying 13).

[J]“If you fast, you will give rise to sin for yourselves; and if you pray, you will be condemned; and if you give alms, you will do harm to your spirits. When you go into any land and walk about in the districts, if they receive you, eat what they will set before you, and heal the sick among them. For what goes into your mouth will not defile you, but that which issues from your mouth; it is that which will defile you.”[/J] (saying 14).
[J]“When you see one who was not born of woman, prostrate yourselves on your faces and worship him. That one is your father.”[/J] (saying 15).
[J]“Men think I have come to cast peace upon the world, but they do not know I have come to cast divisions: fire, sword, war.”[/J] (saying 16).
[J]“Perhaps men think that I have come to cast peace upon the earth. No, rather I have come to cast dissension upon earth: fire, sword, war.”[/J] (saying 16, variant).
[J]“I shall give you what no eye has seen, what no ear has heard, what no hand has touched, and what has not entered the heart of man.”[/J] (saying 17).
[J]“Blessed is he who came into being before he came into being. If you become my disciples and listen to my words, these stones will minister to you.”[/J] (saying 18).
[J]“The kingdom of the Father is like a man who had good seed. His enemy came by night and sowed weeds among the good seed.”[/J] (saying 19–20).

The disciples said to Jesus, “Tell us what the kingdom of heaven is like.” He said to them, [J]“It is like a mustard seed. It is the smallest of all seeds. But when it falls on tilled soil, it produces a great plant and becomes a shelter for birds of the sky.”[/J] (saying 20).
Mary questions Jesus; he replies that true disciples will resemble children (saying 21).
Jesus says, [J]“When you strip without being ashamed and take your clothes and put them under your feet like little children… then you will see the Son of the Living One.”[/J] (saying 22).
[J]“When you make the two one, and the inside like the outside, and the male with the female into a single one, then you will enter the kingdom.”[/J] (saying 22).
[J]“Show me the stone which the builders rejected: that is the cornerstone.”[/J] (saying 23).
[J]“I will choose you, one out of a thousand, and two out of ten thousand, and they will stand as a single one.”[/J] (saying 24–25).
[J]“Love your brother like your soul, guard him like the pupil of your eye.”[/J] (saying 25).
[J]“You see the mote in your brother’s eye, but you do not see the beam in your own.”[/J] (saying 26).
[J]“If you do not fast from the world, you will not find the kingdom; if you do not keep the Sabbath as Sabbath, you will not see the Father.”[/J] (saying 27).
[J]“I stood in the midst of the world, and I appeared to them in flesh. I found all of them drunk; none of them thirsty.”[/J] (saying 28).
[J]“If the flesh came into being because of the spirit, it is a wonder. If the spirit came into being because of the body, it is a wonder of wonders.”[/J] (saying 29).
[J]“Where there are three gods, they are gods. Where there are two or one, I am with him.”[/J] (saying 30).
[J]“No prophet is accepted in his own village; no physician heals those who know him.”[/J] (saying 31).
[J]“A city built on a high hill and fortified cannot fall.”[/J] (saying 32).
[J]“What you hear with one ear, proclaim from your rooftops.”[/J] (saying 33).
[J]“If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”[/J] (saying 34).
[J]“It is not possible for one to enter the strong man’s house and take it by force unless he binds his hands.”[/J] (saying 35).
Disciples ask about what to wear; Jesus says, [J]“Do not be anxious about your clothes. What you will wear, you will not be without.”[/J] (saying 36).

His disciples said, “When will you be revealed to us?” Jesus said, [J]“When you strip without shame and take your garments and put them under your feet as little children, then you will see the Son of the Living One.”[/J] (saying 37).
[J]“Many times have you desired to hear these words, but you have no one to hear them from.”[/J] (saying 38).
[J]“The Pharisees and the scribes have taken the keys of knowledge and hidden them.”[/J] (saying 39).
[J]“A grapevine was planted apart from the Father. Being not strong, it will be pulled up by its roots and destroyed.”[/J] (saying 40).
[J]“Whoever has something in his hand will be given more; whoever has nothing, even what he has will be taken from him.”[/J] (saying 41).
[J]“Become passersby.”[/J] (saying 42).
[J]“A man has guests, but when the banquet is ready, he sends his servant, and the invited do not come.”[/J] (saying 43).
[J]“Blessed is the man who knows at what hour the thieves are coming, so that he may arise and gather his house together.”[/J] (saying 44).
[J]“Jesus said, Whoever among you becomes little will know the kingdom, and he will be greater than John.”[/J] (saying 45).

[J]“From Adam to John the Baptist among those born of women, none is greater than John. Yet I have said, whoever becomes little will know the kingdom, and he will be greater than John.”[/J] (saying 46).
[J]“It is impossible for a man to mount two horses or stretch two bows.”[/J] (saying 47).
[J]“A man is not able to serve two masters.”[/J] (saying 47, continuation).
[J]“If two make peace with each other in this one house, they will say to the mountain, ‘Move Away,’ and it will move away.”[/J] (saying 48).
[J]“Blessed are the solitary and elect, for you will find the kingdom. For you are from it, and to it you will return.”[/J] (saying 49).
[J]“Jesus said, Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me; I myself shall become he, and what is hidden will be revealed.”[/J] (saying 50).
His disciples said, “When will the rest for the dead take place, and when will the new world come?” He said, [J]“What you look for has come, but you do not know it.”[/J] (saying 51).
[J]“Recognize what is before your face, and what is hidden will be revealed.”[/J] (saying 52).
The disciples said, “Circumcision is useful?” He said, [J]“If it were useful, their father would beget them already circumcised.”[/J] (saying 53).
[J]“Blessed is the poor, for yours is the kingdom of heaven.”[/J] (saying 54).
[J]“Whoever does not hate his father and mother cannot be my disciple; whoever does not hate his brothers and sisters and take up his cross will not be worthy of me.”[/J] (saying 55).
[J]“Whoever has come to understand the world has found a corpse, and whoever has found a corpse, of him the world is not worthy.”[/J] (saying 56).
[J]“The kingdom is like a man who had good seed; his enemy came by night and sowed weeds among it.”[/J] (saying 57).
[J]“Blessed is the man who has suffered; he has found life.”[/J] (saying 58).
[J]“Look to the living one while you live, lest you die and seek to see him and be unable.”[/J] (saying 59).
[J]“The Samaritan carrying a lamb into Judea. Jesus said, Why does he carry it? They said, So that he may kill it and eat it.”[/J] (saying 60).
Jesus said to Salome: [J]“I am he who exists from the undivided. From the things of my Father I was given.”[/J] (saying 61).
[J]“Two will rest on a bed; one will die, one will live.”[/J] (saying 62).
[J]“Whoever is near me is near the fire; whoever is far from me is far from the kingdom.”[/J] (saying 63).
[J]“A rich man had many possessions. He said, “I will use my wealth to sow and reap.” But that night he died.”[/J] (saying 64).
[J]“A man invited guests, but when the banquet was ready, they excused themselves. The master compelled others to come.”[/J] (saying 65).
[J]“Show me the stone which the builders rejected; that is the cornerstone.”[/J] (saying 66).
[J]“Whoever knows the All but is lacking himself is lacking everything.”[/J] (saying 67).
[J]“Blessed are you when hated and persecuted; where they persecute you, they will not find a place.”[/J] (saying 68).
[J]“Blessed are those persecuted within themselves; they have truly come to know the Father.”[/J] (saying 69).
[J]“If you bring forth what is within you, what you bring forth will save you. If you do not, it will destroy you.”[/J] (saying 70).
[J]“I will destroy this house, and none will be able to build it.”[/J] (saying 71).
[J]“A man said, Speak to my brothers, divide my father’s possessions. Jesus said, Who made me a divider?”[/J] (saying 72).
[J]“The harvest is great but the workers are few.”[/J] (saying 73).
[J]“Lord, many are standing around the well, but no one enters the well.”[/J] (saying 74).
[J]“There are many standing at the door, but only the solitary will enter the bridal chamber.”[/J] (saying 75).
[J]“The kingdom is like a merchant with merchandise who found a pearl. The wise merchant sold everything and bought the pearl.”[/J] (saying 76).
[J]“It is I who am the light above them all. It is I who am the All.”[/J] (saying 77).
[J]“Why did you go out into the desert? To see a reed shaken by the wind? To see a man in soft raiment?”[/J] (saying 78).
[J]“A woman in the crowd said, Blessed is the womb that bore you and the breasts that nourished you. He said, Blessed are those who have heard the word of the Father and kept it.”[/J] (saying 79).
[J]“He who has recognized the world has found the body, but he who has found the body, of him the world is not worthy.”[/J] (saying 80).
[J]“He who has become rich, let him become king; and he who has power, let him renounce it.”[/J] (saying 81).
[J]“He who is near me is near the fire; he who is far from me is far from the kingdom.”[/J] (saying 82).
[J]“Images are seen by man, but the light within them is hidden.”[/J] (saying 83).
[J]“When you see your likeness you rejoice, but when you see your images which came into being before you, you will mourn.”[/J] (saying 84).
[J]“Adam came into being from a great power and great wealth, but he did not become worthy of you.”[/J] (saying 85).
[J]“Foxes have their holes, and birds have their nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”[/J] (saying 86).
[J]“Wretched is the body dependent upon a body, and wretched is the soul dependent on these two.”[/J] (saying 87).
[J]“The angels and prophets will come to you and give you what is yours.”[/J] (saying 88).
[J]“Why do you wash the outside of the cup? Do you not know that inside you is full of wickedness?”[/J] (saying 89).
[J]“Come to me, for my yoke is easy and my lordship is mild, and you will find rest for yourselves.”[/J] (saying 90).
They said to him, “Tell us who you are, so that we may believe in you.” He said, [J]“You test the face of the sky, but you do not know the one before you.”[/J] (saying 91).
[J]“Seek, and you will find. In the past, I did not answer you, but now I am willing to give.”[/J] (saying 92).
[J]“Do not give what is holy to dogs, or cast pearls before swine.”[/J] (saying 93).
Jesus said, [J]“Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me; I myself shall become he, and the hidden things will be revealed.”[/J] (saying 94).
[J]“The kingdom of the Father is like a woman carrying a jar of meal. The handle of the jar broke, and she did not notice until it was empty.”[/J] (saying 95).
[J]“The kingdom of the Father is like a woman carrying a jar full of meal, which broke unnoticed until empty.”[/J] (saying 96, variant).
[J]“The kingdom is like a man who wanted to kill a powerful man. He drew his sword in his house and thrust it into the wall to test his strength.”[/J] (saying 97).
[J]“The kingdom of the Father is like a man who wished to kill a noble man. He drew his sword in his house; he killed him and became king in place of him.”[/J] (saying 98).
“The disciples said, Tell us about the kingdom. He said, [J]It is like a mustard seed; it is the smallest of seeds, but when it falls on tilled soil, it grows into a large plant.”[/J] (saying 99).
“Jesus said, [J]Whoever does not hate his father and mother as I do cannot be my disciple. Whoever does not love his father and mother as I do cannot be my disciple.”[/J] (saying 100).
[J]“Whoever does not hate his father and mother as I do cannot be my disciple. For my mother gave me falsehood, but my true mother gave me life.”[/J] (saying 101).
[J]“Woe to the Pharisees, for they are like a dog lying in the manger of the oxen, not eating and not letting the oxen eat.”[/J] (saying 102).
[J]“Blessed is the man who knows where the brigands will enter, so that he may arise and gather his strength and arm himself before they come in.”[/J] (saying 103).

They said to Jesus, “Come, let us pray today and fast”. Jesus said, [J]“What sin have I committed, or in what have I been defeated? But when the bridegroom leaves the bridal chamber, then let them fast.”[/J] (saying 104).
[J]“Whoever knows father and mother will be called the son of a harlot.”[/J] (saying 105).
[J]“When you make the two one, you will become the sons of man; and if you say, Mountain, move away, it will move.”[/J] (saying 106).
[J]“The kingdom is like a shepherd who had a hundred sheep. The largest strayed; he left the ninety-nine and sought it until he found it.”[/J] (saying 107).
[J]“Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me; I myself will become he.”[/J] (saying 108).
[J]“The kingdom is like a man who had a treasure hidden in his field. He did not know of it; when he died he left it to his son, who discovered and sold it.”[/J] (saying 109).
Jesus said, [J]“Whoever has found the world and become rich, let him renounce the world.”[/J] (saying 110).
[J]“The heavens and the earth will be rolled up in your presence. And the living from the living will not see death.”[/J] (saying 111).
[J]“Woe to the flesh that depends on the soul; woe to the soul that depends on the flesh.”[/J] (saying 112, variant order here is 112 in some mss but placed at 11 in Coptic).
[J]“Woe to the flesh that depends on the soul; woe to the soul that depends on the flesh.”[/J] (saying 112).
[J]“Angels and prophets will come to you, and they will give you what is yours. And you too, give them what you have.”[/J] (saying 113).

Simon Peter said, Let Mary leave us, for women are not worthy of life. Jesus said, [J]“Behold, I shall lead her, so that I will make her male, that she too may become a living spirit resembling you males. For every woman who makes herself male will enter the kingdom of heaven.”[/J] (saying 114).
crossRefs: Matthew 7:7: Seek and you will find.
Luke 17:21: The kingdom of God is within you.
Matthew 19:30: The last will be first.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: מַלְכוּת (malkût), Greek: βασιλεία (basileía), Aramaic: מלכותא (malkûtāʾ)
translationNotes.note: Means reign or rule; in Thomas, emphasized as both inward and outward reality rather than a distant place.

stories.keyTakeaway: The opening sayings stress seeking, discovery, hidden knowledge, and the kingdom within and without.
